text:
inc-bot: ALERT: Pager delivery errors detected for team 'core-infra' — 83 pages failed in last 10m. Error: 502 from /pagerflow/webhook
ops-lead: anyone oncall?
josh: I'm paged but didn't get call. I only see a slack notification from inc-bot.
laura: same, no SMS or call. I see a 502 spike in pagerproxy logs.
dinesh: grabbing logs. looks like batching endpoint returned 502 when tenant header present, but when header missing it goes through.
ops-lead: @pagerflow-bot show recent webhook logs
pagerflow-bot: last 5 webhook responses: 200,200,502,502,502 (x83 failures). Cause likely client header validation change.
maria: manual page to mobile worked. SRE contact reached via phone.
sre-oncall: confirmed received manual page and acked the incident. Investigating whether integration changed validation for X-Tenant-ID.
laura: here's a snippet from proxy logs:
```
[2026-03-18T12:03:21Z] POST /v1/push tenant=acct-42 -> 502 "invalid header: tenant-id"
[2026-03-18T12:04:05Z] POST /v1/push tenant= -> 200
```
ops-lead: so automated requests are now including a `tenant` header not `X-Tenant-ID` field. New SDK/agent rollout maybe.
dinesh: rolling a quick patch to accept both headers on proxy. Applying hotfix to staging then prod.
josh: any customer impact?
ops-lead: we sent ~83 failed pages; manual SMS succeeded for priority oncalls. No escalations so far, but one customer support ticket reported delayed response.
maria: flagged to support and notified the impacted team. creating incident page.
ops-lead: mitigation: (1) enable SMS fallback in pagerflow config (done), (2) hotfix header compatibility (in progress), (3) roll back agent change if patch fails.
pagerflow-bot: SMS fallback enabled for core-infra at 12:15 UTC.
sre-oncall: hotfix deployed to prod at 12:22, error rate dropped to zero.
ops-lead: good. moving to postmortem. @dinesh, @josh write initial timeline. @maria file customer comms. We'll schedule RCA tomorrow.
josh: ack. will paste timeline.
inc-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED — pages resumed. Runbook: incidents/pagerflow-compatibility. tagging priority: sev3 :white_check_mark:
ops-lead: thanks all. quick retro: add unit tests for header variants and add alert to detect spike in 5xx at webhook -> paging failures.
maria: noted; creating follow-up tickets. :memo:
